title: COESA Atmosphere Model
text: Implement 1976 COESA lower atmosphere, 1 input, 4 outputs, {Frequency of occurrence} sets Model type; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Specification} sets the atmosphere model type 1976 COESA-extended U.S. Standard, {Atmospheric model type} sets the model type, {Extreme parameter} sets the model type High, {Altitude of extreme value} sets the geometric altitude 5 km and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Specification
params.values: Atmosphere model type 1976 COESA-extended U.S. Standard Atmosphere (default) | MIL-HDBK-310 | MIL-STD-210C

params.name: Extreme parameter
params.values: Model type High temperature (default) | Low temperature | High density | Low density | High pressure | Low pressure

params.name: Altitude of extreme value
params.values: Geometric altitude 5 km (16404 ft) (default) | 10 km (32808 ft) | 20 km (65617 ft) | 30 km (98425 ft) | 40 km (131234 ft)

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error
